> Path rule · Scope: common · Owns proportional physical structure

# Physical Structure Rules

Physical structure follows actual responsibilities. Do not create speculative
projects, infrastructure, empty directory trees, or generic `Common`,
`Helpers`, or `Utils` buckets solely to make the repository look
architectural; create a directory or project only when it holds meaningful,
cohesive content.

Repository layout: `docs/capabilities/architecture.md`. Creating or
reorganizing projects: `project-structure` workflow.
